mechanism_narrative: The four-week monotonic erosion in WORKPLACES mobility (from -21.7 to -27.1) removes commuter weekday footfall that retail-and-recreation venues depend on, so RETAIL_REC keeps falling over the next four weeks rather than reverting.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell in three of the last four weekly means, ending at -27.1
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its mean over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES remains at or below -25.0 in every week.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT crossing below the -25 percent threshold (t-0w at -26.3) marks a discrete break in trip-making that propagates to discretionary retail trips within two weeks, pushing RETAIL_REC lower before any stabilisation.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean crosses below -25.0 percent change (observed -26.3 at t-0w)
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from -22.3 at t-2w to -26.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: In the two weeks after TRANSIT first prints below -25.0, RETAIL_REC weekly means average above the -24.4 print at t-0w.

mechanism_narrative: Households switch to essentials-only shopping when GROCERY_PHARM turns negative (-2.7) while RESIDENTIAL stays above baseline above +1.0; the combination signals home-anchored consumption that starves discretionary retail of footfall.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM prints a negative weekly mean while RESIDENTIAL stays above +1.0
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell from +2.7 at t-2w to -2.7 at t-0w while RESIDENTIAL remained positive
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises in the two weeks following a joint negative GROCERY_PHARM and positive RESIDENTIAL print in more than half of observed weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-July Madrid enters a summer-evening and tourist-driven regime in which PARKS staying above baseline signals outdoor footfall that spills into adjacent retail-and-recreation venues, lifting RETAIL_REC above its depressed four-week mean.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS stayed positive in all four weekly means despite falling from 12.4 to 1.9
regime_hint: mid-summer post-curfew reopening with tourism intake
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is below its last-28-day mean while PARKS weekly means stay above +1.0 throughout.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL remaining above baseline for four consecutive weeks keeps a persistent share of discretionary spending at home, so the retail-and-recreation deficit is structural rather than transient and RETAIL_REC stays below its own four-week mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL printed +3.4, +1.1, +1.6, +1.3 while RETAIL_REC fell to -24.4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean exceeds its last-28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL stays at or above +1.0 every week.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed containment response to rising transmission compresses TRANSIT and WORKPLACES simultaneously, and the first-week reaction of RETAIL_REC to that compression is negative before any adaptive reallocation of trips occurs.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both decline week-on-week by more than 1.0 point in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES fell together between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC in the week after a joint TRANSIT and WORKPLACES decline of more than 1.0 point is higher than in the week before that decline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous contraction across TRANSIT, WORKPLACES and GROCERY_PHARM at t-0w indicates a broad, non-substituting demand pullback rather than a shift between categories, so RETAIL_REC has no compensating inflow and declines further within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT, WORKPLACES and GROCERY_PHARM all print week-on-week declines in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:all three series fell at t-0w relative to t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC in the week following a joint three-series decline is at or above its value in the preceding week.

mechanism_narrative: The collapse of PARKS from 12.4 to 1.9 as July heat peaks pushes leisure trips into air-conditioned indoor destinations, redirecting outdoor-bound demand into malls and hospitality and lifting RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by more than 5.0 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS dropped from 12.4 at t-2w to 1.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: In the two weeks after a PARKS week-on-week drop greater than 5.0 points, RETAIL_REC means are lower than the mean of the two preceding weeks.
